notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Changes:
-a bug was fixed where a door would not open in one of the puzzles in heaven zone
-optimization has been improved

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Changes:

-Fixed mouse sensitivity bug
-Added intro to the start of new game
-Added 7 easter eggs
-Added camera zoom (press RMB to zoom)
-Fixed achievements bug
-Fixed a bug where the sound volume of voice lines did not change with the overall sound volume

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes:
-The respawn button no longer resets open doors, it simply teleports the player to the nearest checkpoint. The teleport to start button still reloads the level entirely.
